# CodeBook

## Source of the Data

The original data comes from the UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones Dataset which can be accessed here: http://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/Human+Activity+Recognition+Using+Smartphones

## Description of Variables

The tidy data set includes the following variables:

- subject: An integer identifying each participant, numbered 1 through 30.
- activity: The type of activity performed, with descriptive values:
  - WALKING
  - WALKING_UPSTAIRS
  - WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS
  - SITTING
  - STANDING
  - LAYING
- Remaining variables: The average of each mean or standard deviation measurement for each subject-activity pair, e.g.:
  - tBodyAcc-mean()-X
  - tBodyGyro-std()-Z
  - etc.

These are derived from 561 raw features. Only those with “mean()” or “std()” in the name were retained.

## Transformations Performed

As described in the comments in the code and the project instructions...

1. Merged the training and test sets into one data set.
2. Extracted only the measurements on the mean and standard deviation.
3. Labeled the activities with descriptive names.
4. Cleaned variable names for clarity.
5. Created a tidy data set that contains the average of each variable for each subject and activity.
